name: Sim viewer
description: Runs a Mega Bot team scene on the real Sigmally server code (the sig-server repo, in-process) and plays it back: every piece, where each bot is aiming, what it says it's doing, eats and splits.
agent: Use to show the user a behaviour in the team sim: sim_scenes lists scenes, sim_run runs one (any bot version file) and shows it in the panel; the user watches and can tell you what's wrong.
